missions.name: SCHOOL ZONE
missions.subtitle: CONTROL YOUR SPEED
missions.objective: Slow down to 20 km/h and stop for crossing pedestrians.

missions.name: INTERSECTION
missions.subtitle: OBEY THE SIGNAL
missions.objective: Stop at the red light and cross only on green.

missions.name: EMERGENCY VEHICLE
missions.subtitle: GIVE WAY
missions.objective: Pull over to the right and stop to allow the ambulance to pass.

missions.name: DISTRACTION
missions.subtitle: STAY FOCUSED
missions.objective: Ignore phone alerts and keep your full attention on the road.

missions.name: FINAL CITY DRIVE
missions.subtitle: APPLY EVERYTHING
missions.objective: Maintain safe speed, watch for hazards, and drive to the finish line!
